description: What a creator shipped recently and which of it beat THEIR OWN baseline: fetches their recent posts once and scores each against the median of that same window, because a raw view count mostly measures follower count — outperformance against themselves is the signal. If they are on your watchlist it also marks what is new since your last track_creator call and moves that marker forward. Consumes 2 nooticr credits — one post list, whatever the window size. Use to track a competitor, keep an eye on a rival, see how someone is doing lately, or catch what they shipped since you last looked; analyze_creator_profile is for a one-off profile teardown.

limit.description: Posts in the window (default 12, max 30). One fetch either way.

metric.description: Which stat to rank on (default views).

platform.description: Platform. Defaults to tiktok, so SET IT whenever the user named a network — otherwise a question about X, LinkedIn or Reddit is silently answered with TikTok data, and an empty result looks like the account does not exist. Accepts what get_user_posts does: tiktok, instagram, youtube, douyin, xiaohongshu, twitter, bilibili, linkedin, reddit, weibo.

since.description: Only posts published on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD. Ignored where the platform returns no post dates — `sinceApplied` says which happened.

username.description: Creator handle, with or without @. This is a handle, not a brand name — if you only have a company name, find the handle first (search_creators on TikTok, Instagram or Xiaohongshu; a web search anywhere else).

name: track_creator

median.description: The creator's own median — what outperformance is measured against.

baseline.description: Null when there are too few posts to call anything a baseline.

evidenceFrom.description: The cheap calls this was assembled from.

frameIndex.description: Where each returned frame sits in the video.

guidance.description: What to do with this payload, in prose. Read it: it is the instruction, not a summary.

lastCheckedAt.description: When track_creator last looked, or null on a first look.

cached.description: true when the answer was served from the server's cache, at no cost.

charged.description: false when the call was refused before anything was debited.

metric.description: Which stat everything here is ranked on.

mode.description: Always "evidence": this payload is material you have still to read.

newSincePreviousCheck.description: Posts not seen at the last check; null when there was none.

outperformers.description: postIds of the posts that beat the median by a quarter or more.

id.description: The platform's own id for the post, passed through untouched.

isNew.description: True when it was not there at the last check; null without one.

ratio.description: This post over the creator's median. The number to quote.

verdict.description: breakout, above_baseline, typical, below_baseline, flop or no_baseline.

posts.description: The window, best against their own median first.

tracked.description: True when this creator is on the watchlist, which is what makes a diff possible.

window.description: Posts in the window actually scored.

title: Track Competitor
